issues.description: The problem statement (UML and text) indicates the Farm's animals list should be a private attribute with getter and setter (aggregation shown as '- animals: List<Animal>' and text: 'Also, don't forget to implement a getter and a setter'). In the provided solution, the animals field is declared public (public List<Animal> animals;), which contradicts the intended encapsulation and the instructions to provide getter/setter. This mismatch can confuse students about the required visibility and design (they are instructed to implement a private field with accessors but the reference solution exposes the field publicly).
issues.suggestedFix: Ensure the animals attribute follows the intended encapsulation: declare it private (private List<Animal> animals;), initialize it in the no-arg constructor, and provide public getAnimals()/setAnimals(...) methods. Update the solution (and any example/template comments) so the visibility matches the UML and the textual instructions.
